headline.en: Write down the work you are deliberately leaving out.
headline.zh: 把明确不做的工作写下来。

sub.en: negplan gives a coding task a portable Markdown ledger with allowed work, excluded work and the reasons for both. The current CLI creates and validates that document.
sub.zh: negplan 为编码任务提供可携带的 Markdown 台账，记录计划实施、明确排除的工作及原因。当前 CLI 可以创建并校验这份文档。

body.en: Each excluded item keeps its rationale.
Markdown can travel with the project.
The validator reports fields that violate the schema.
body.zh: 校验器报告违反 schema 的字段。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Node.js 22+; parse the complete example ledger, round-trip it and reject an invalid lifecycle status.
note.zh: 需要 Node.js 22+；解析完整台账示例，完成序列化往返，并拒绝无效生命周期状态。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Offline parsing, schema validation and serialization of a complete scope ledger, including an invalid-status example; no diff enforcement is performed.

body.en: Node.js 22+; parse the complete example ledger, round-trip it and reject an invalid lifecycle status.
body.zh: 需要 Node.js 22+；解析完整台账示例，完成序列化往返，并拒绝无效生命周期状态。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/negplan.git
cd negplan
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: Diff-hunk gating and the interactive veto/override renderer are not implemented. Their commands print roadmap text and may exit zero; do not use them as an enforcement gate.
limitations.zh: diff hunk 门禁与交互式否决/覆盖界面尚未实现。对应命令打印路线图文字并可能返回零；不可将其用于强制门禁。

limitations.en: Validation checks document structure, not whether planned work is appropriate or whether generated code follows it.
limitations.zh: 校验检查文档结构，不判断计划是否合理，也不验证生成代码是否遵守约定。

limitations.en: The table parser is a focused format parser, not a complete Markdown implementation. Keep entries in the supplied table format.
limitations.zh: 表格解析器只支持特定格式，不是完整 Markdown 实现；条目应沿用提供的表格格式。

body.en: An exclusion is easier to discuss when it has an ID and rationale beside the requested work. Keeping the agreement in a file makes it available to a person or any agent that can read Markdown.
body.zh: 排除项与需求并列、带有 ID 和原因时，更容易讨论。把约定保存在文件中，人或能读取 Markdown 的 Agent 都可使用。

body.en: init expands a Markdown template. The parser reads YAML frontmatter and three table sections into a typed ledger; a focused validator checks the shipped schema, and serializeLedger writes the canonical form. gate and render are milestone placeholders.
body.zh: init 展开 Markdown 模板；解析器将 YAML frontmatter 与三个表格章节读成类型化台账，专用校验器检查随仓 schema，serializeLedger 写出规范格式。gate 与 render 仍是里程碑占位。

body.en: init expands a Markdown template. The parser reads YAML frontmatter and three table sections into a typed ledger; a focused validator checks the shipped schema, and serializeLedger writes the canonical form. gate and render are milestone placeholders.
body.zh: init 展开 Markdown 模板；解析器将 YAML frontmatter 与三个表格章节读成类型化台账，专用校验器检查随仓 schema，serializeLedger 写出规范格式。gate 与 render 仍是里程碑占位。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: A ledger starts with task, optional agent/created_at and status (drafting, negotiating, gating or done). will_implement rows contain id, summary and rationale; will_not_implement adds overridden. gates defines change_id, file, hunk, entry_id, verdict and human_override for future enforcement records. init --force overwrites an existing file; omit it to preserve an existing agreement.
body.zh: 台账开头包含 task、可选 agent/created_at 与 status（drafting、negotiating、gating 或 done）。will_implement 行含 id、summary、rationale；will_not_implement 还包含 overridden。gates 定义 change_id、file、hunk、entry_id、verdict、human_override，供后续门禁记录使用。init --force 会覆盖已有文件；不加时保留现有约定。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
node dist/src/cli.js init --task "Add CSV export" --output .negplan.md
# Fill the allowed/excluded entries in .negplan.md, then:
node dist/src/cli.js validate --file .negplan.md
node dist/src/cli.js validate --file examples/example-ledger.md
